claim_text: Single-grain out-of-plane strain vs temperature departs from the thermoelastic slope with hysteresis, and after the first heating it follows the film average

steps.observation: Single-grain strain loops leave the thermoelastic line: slopes are much lower and heating and cooling branches do not coincide
steps.image_note: Syn cycle 1 starts at -0.057% and ends at -0.167% after cooling (more compressive out-of-plane); text quotes 95 MPa -> 250 MPa in-plane stress; text also quotes M111 = 188.6 MPa, which must be GPa

panels.caption_span: Out-of-plane lattice strain is reported for three successive thermal cycles. The first cycle was measured with a laboratory source (red line) and is relative to a large number of (111)-oriented grains. The second cycle (green line) is deduced from the average position of the coherent diffraction pattern of the single investigated grain (see Fig. 5). A third cycle was measured (blue line) in the same conditions as the one used in the second cycle. The ideal thermoelastic slope is also represented (cyan line)

steps.observation: Lab (film average) loop and synchrotron cycle 2 nearly coincide; synchrotron cycle 1 heating branch lies well above both
requires_unseen: Lab cycle = average over many (111) grains, Syn cycles = the single grain (caption)
